# devbydima

> devbydima is a solo developer making small games and apps for Android. The current release is Whoa, What Changed?, a free, single-player, offline-capable memory game where you spot what changed in a hand-drawn scene.

## Whoa, What Changed?

- [Game page](https://devbydima.github.io/whatchanged/): features, screenshots, FAQ and trailer
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=devbydima.whatchanged): install the game on Android
- [Trailer](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KbuVq59s0Uo): short trailer on YouTube
- [Privacy policy](https://devbydima.github.io/whatchanged/privacy-policy/): what the app does and does not collect

## About the game

- Platform: Android. Free to play, works offline, no account needed. One optional purchase removes full-screen ads.
- A round takes 10 to 20 seconds: memorize a hand-drawn scene, blink, then tap what changed. Sometimes nothing changed, and boss rounds have two changes.
- About 135 levels across 7 themes: Kitchen, Forest, Space, Sea, Toy room, Circus and Dinosaurs.
- Single-player game: levels, daily challenge, endless mode, hardcore and challenge levels. Switcheroo is an optional extra mode for two players on one phone.
- Eight languages: English, Nederlands, Deutsch, Espanol, Francais, Portugues, Italiano and Bahasa Indonesia.
- For ages 13 and over. Progress stays on the phone and there are no accounts.
